(1) STU-VID-062 refusal before encoding: Muxer::new refuses unsupported combinations (mux-mp4-cannot-carry-vc3, mux-mp4-pcm-rate-above-65535, mux-pcm-bit-depth, mux-no-tracks) and hostile bounds (mux-dimensions, mux-zero-dimension, mux-zero-frame-duration, mux-frame-rate-not-representable, mux-pcm-layout, mux-config-bytes) before a byte is written; per-sample bounds checked before the write; mux-pts-not-a-permutation and empty tracks refused at finish

(2) reel src/vc3/encode.rs Vc3Encoder (Studio-owned, from SMPTE ST 2019-1:2016): inverse of reel's VC-3 decoder (same Annex E tables, Figure 48 zig-zag, equation 8.1 dequantization, transposed decoder IDCT basis); profiles DNxHR LB/SQ/HQ (CID 1274/1273/1272, 8-bit) and HQX (1271, 10-bit) 4:2:2 or 4:2:0 at any raster 1..=16384 (even width), DNxHD 1235/1237/1238/1253 (1920x1080) and 1250/1251/1252 (1280x720) 4:2:2; CBR coding units: Table C.1 sizes, RI equation (7.1) (ri_frame_size; 264x120 HQ = 16384 like ffmpeg's frames); one qsf per frame, smallest fitting 1..=2047 by bisection seeded with the previous frame; augmentation by edge replication; scan-line 32-bit padding and scan indices; CLV from the frame matrix (709 -> 0, 2020 NCL/CL -> 1/2, else out-of-band 3); refusals before allocation (vc3-encode-dimensions, -zero-dimension, -odd-dimension, -bit-depth, -chroma, -profile-raster, -planes, -plane-size, -sample-range); dnx_descriptor can_encode = true

(2) reel src/export.rs ExportQueue (STU-VID-064): submit -> ExportHandle (Clone + Send: progress {state queued/running/complete/failed/canceled, done, total}, cancel before or during the run), run() executes items in order and returns one ExportReceipt per item (recipe_id, artifact, source span, outcome, container, codec, encoder id/version, muxer id/version, frames, audio frames, clipped samples, bytes, SHA-256, verified, MuxReceipt; to_json without paths); ExportRecipe {recipe_id, container, video: Vc3(profile) | Av1(settings), audio: PCM bits/float} (STU-VID-063); ports ExportVideoSource (planes per frame) and ExportAudioSource (interleaved f32 mixdown); plan() refuses every combination and bound before the first frame (STU-VID-062: encoder config, muxer combination, frame/audio budgets, source/recipe mismatch, output exists without overwrite); AV1 without the feature = MEDIA_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE av1 (STU-VID-051.3); audio interleaved after each frame by exact integer tick arithmetic; PCM quantization nearest with clamp count; temp sibling file (create_new) -> fsync -> reel re-index (sample counts must match) -> rename; on failure/cancel the temp file is removed and the output path untouched

(3) reel src/av1_encode.rs (feature av1-encode, rav1e 0.8.1, default-features off): Av1Encoder over Context<u8>/<u16> (8/10-bit, 4:2:0/4:2:2/4:4:4), constant-quantizer or bitrate rate control, speed 0..=10, keyframe interval, BT.709/2020/PQ/HLG colour description; every rav1e call in catch_unwind (av1-encoder-fault, encoder then refuses further use); bounds before rav1e allocates (av1-encode-dimensions 8192/side and 8192x4352 px, -bit-depth, -mono, -odd-dimension, -speed, -keyframe-interval, -zero-bitrate, -bitrate <= 1 Gbit/s, -planes, -plane-size, -after-finish); one temporal unit per shown frame in presentation order; config_record = rav1e av1C header + the sequence header OBU of the first temporal unit (bounded OBU walk)

(4) harness src/view/timeline_export.rs (feature media): TimelineVideo (reel ExportVideoSource) renders frame in + i*tpf of the sequence through ProgramMonitor::render_at (pulse frame layers, transitions as weighted pairs, composite render_scene on render-cpu) and converts the R'G'B' frame to BT.709 limited-range Y'CbCr at 8/10 bits with box-averaged 4:2:2/4:2:0 chroma (rgb_to_planes); a monitor refusal fails the item (export-frame-unavailable / -codec-unavailable / -render-failed), never a black frame; TimelineAudio (ExportAudioSource) streams pulse's TimelineMixStream (score mixdown, stereo) from the exact start sample; timeline_export_job builds the reel ExportJob (span = [in, out) ticks) and refuses before rendering: range not whole frames or in >= out (export_range), audio start between samples, monitor raster the monitor refuses (monitor_size), mixdown pulse cannot plan
